# netbox_inventory_item_template (Data Source)

An inventory item template of a device type (dcim.inventoryitemtemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/inventoryitemtemplate/):

> **Deprecation Warning:** Beginning in NetBox v4.3, the use of inventory items has been deprecated. They are planned for removal in a future NetBox release. Users are strongly encouraged to begin using [modules](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/module/) and [module types](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/moduletype/) in place of inventory items. Modules provide enhanced functionality and can be configured with user-defined attributes.
>
> A template for an inventory item that will be automatically created when instantiating a new device. All attributes of this object will be copied to the new inventory item, including the associations with a parent item and assigned component, if any. See the [inventory item](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/inventoryitem/) documentation for more detail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_inventory_item_template" "test" {
  name = "test-inventory_item_template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. NetBox refuses to move a template to another type.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent inventory item template.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the inventory item role.

### Read-Only

- `component_id` (Number) Id of the component template named by component_type.
- `component_type` (String) Type of the component template the item is bound to, e.g. dcim.interfacetemplate. Requires component_id.
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer part number.
- `url` (String)
